verdict.rationale: The Jeeves API authenticates with OAuth 2.0 and mTLS, so issuing API credentials to an agent integration is documented. Customizable roles and permissions exist for team members, but nothing shows these scope API or MCP credentials. Missing for 10: documented OAuth scopes or permission sets for API/MCP credentials, least-privilege or read-only agent tokens, per-agent credential issuance and revocation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
